overview_description.description: Zarvista Capital Markets is an online forex and multi-asset trading platform that provides brokerage services for individuals and institutional traders. The platform allows users to trade financial instruments such as foreign exchange (forex), commodities, indices, and CFDs (contracts for difference) through digital trading software and brokerage tools.

about_short_description.short_description: Zarvista Capital Markets is an online forex and multi-asset trading platform.

product.name: Forex Trading
product.description: A service enabling trading of global currency pairs with access to liquidity and fast execution.

product.name: Cryptocurrency Trading
product.description: A platform for trading various cryptocurrencies including Bitcoin, Ethereum, and altcoins with instant execution.

product.name: Precious Metals Trading
product.description: Trading service for precious metals like gold, silver, platinum, and palladium to diversify investment portfolios.

product.name: CFD Trading
product.description: A service allowing trading of Contracts for Difference on various underlying assets like indices and stocks.

product.name: Trading Accounts
product.description: Four types of trading accounts tailored to different trader profiles with varying spreads, commissions, and minimum deposits.

product.name: Social Copy Trading
product.description: A service that allows traders to follow and replicate trades of experienced traders automatically.
